_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): email-based password reset — single-use hashed tokens with TTL, forgot + reset endpoints, anti-enumeration response, composes feature-email for delivery (log fallback).
name: feature-password-reset
description: Password reset flow: single-use hashed tokens (TTL), forgot + reset endpoints, emails via feature-email (log fallback).
notes: Requires feature-auth (User model, auth_service). After applying: 1) app.include_router(router), 2) make sure the model is imported (Base.metadata.create_all runs at app import), 3) set APP_BASE_URL for the reset link + SMTP_* env vars for delivery (see feature-email); in development the token logs to stdout instead. NOTE: the reset email sends to the username — if usernames are not emails, add an email column to the User model (feature-auth) and send there. Forgot-password always returns 202 to avoid user enumeration.
